newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh could face second storm in eight days.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh could face second storm in eight days.

text.p: Another storm from the Andaman Sea off Burma could move towards Bangladesh, the second in eight days, weather officials warned on Tuesday.
Officials with the mateorological department said a depression in the Anadaman sea on Tuesday could turn into a cyclonic storm and affect Bangladesh.
"There is a 50-50 chance that we will be hit by a fresh strom," one official said.

A cyclone from the Bay of Bengal battered Bangladesh's coast and offshore islands on May 19, killing at least 111 people, according to official figures. Thousands also were injured and more than one million left homeless.
The depression in the Anadaman sea had already led to widespread rain on Bangladesh's coast on Tuesday, adding to the suffering of cyclone survivors, weather officials said.
